criteria.no: Applying it needs outside knowledge: the meaning of a subjective quality, an unexplained label or code, or an unrecorded approval.
criteria.unclear: It is unclear whether some term needs outside knowledge.
criteria.yes: No outside knowledge is needed; the statement uses common technical vocabulary and concrete content only.

self_contained.instructions: Does applying `anchor.statement` require knowledge that is not in the statement itself? Answer yes when nothing outside is needed. Common technical vocabulary (commands, paths, flags, formats, streams, environment variables, named tools) is not outside knowledge. A subjective quality word, an unexplained label or requirement code, or a person's approval that is not recorded anywhere is outside knowledge.

anchor.statement: For each input file in tests/fixtures/, the formatter output must be byte-identical to the file with the same name and an .expected suffix in that directory.
anchor.quote: for every file in tests/fixtures the formatter output has to match the .expected file next to it byte for byte
